visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a grey sweatshirt and blue trousers is lying on a large white bed in a minimalist hotel room. A digital projector is visible on the ceiling, and the headboard area is composed of vertical grey padded panels with integrated warm lighting. (2) The bed headrest slowly elevates through a motorized mechanism, transforming the flat bed into a comfortable sofa position while the woman smiles and waves at the camera. Emojis and colorful captions appear as overlays. (3) A series of quick montage cuts displays a smartphone screen with an alarm settings app, followed by a view of a projector screen descending from the ceiling and a suitcase being tucked into a storage compartment underneath the elevated bed frame. (4) The sequence continues showing various hotel amenities: a compact modern bathroom with a white toilet and glass-walled shower, and a large common lounge area featuring long wooden tables, hanging geometric lights, and a self-service coffee and beer station. (5) The woman is shown sitting comfortably on the converted sofa bed, using a remote control to watch a colorful animation projected onto the large screen. The video concludes with a graphical splash screen with social media handles.
